description: Per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-07-opening-art-music-prototypes-design.md's 3-treatment framing ("Hybrid -- expected winner: CC0 stone/forest foundation plus deterministic original runes, spell effects, and Composer music"), this treatment needs no new asset production of its own. This file only records that pairing so #128's engine-wiring pass has one place to read the intended asset list from, without duplicating any binary file.

notBuiltThisPass: No Phaser scene wiring, no engine code, no new binary asset. Per the design spec's own ticket ordering, assembling any treatment into the actual Active Prototype scene (loading these paths via this.load.*, arranging them in a running scene) is issue #128's job, not this one's.
